title: Thundertree · Area 3 · Brown Horse

sourceRecords.title: Thundertree 3 · The Brown Horse
read: A faded horse sign hangs above the door of an old tavern. Inside, forms slump against the walls and beneath the bar.

The hanging sign gives the ruin a name even though its hospitality is long gone. The slumped forms are visible among the remains of ordinary tavern furnishings. You can stop at the doorway to study them, call into the room, or decide where to stand before entering.

brief: Abandoned Brown Horse tavern. Weathered horse-shaped sign, roof largely intact, interior viewed from doorway. Eastern common room with ruined bar; western brewing/kitchen area with HUGE wooden ale tuns. FOUR ash-covered human zombie forms slump motionlessly against walls or beneath bar, initial observable state before rising. No active attack, drinks, living patrons or flaming zombies. Dusty daylight, cold hearth.
